source: League of Legends Wiki · Item group, cross-referenced against Riot Data Dragon and current official role-quest patch notes
reviewNote: Every group member was resolved against exact name and current map-11 availability. Members absent from the normal shop are recorded as unavailable or role-quest/transformation entries; they are not silently treated as purchasable. Group reference is cross-checked against Riot Data Dragon 16.22.1 and official 26.1/26.2 role-quest notes. Transformed Archangel/Muramana finals inherit their Manaflow/Lifeline exclusivity groups.

roleQuestRules.note: Quest inventory is represented separately. Only a Bot quest boot item may occupy the separate boot slot after quest completion; Mid tier-3 boots replace the equipped pair; support control wards are not main inventory slots.
roleQuestRules.supportFinalItemSource: Data Dragon 16.22.1 final support quest upgrades; explicit role required
